rapidboard-fullstack.description: Development of a GitHub repository analytics platform, from data extraction and organization to authentication and dashboards for tracking team activity.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented an ETL pipeline to extract commits, pull requests and issues from the GitHub REST API and load them into PostgreSQL, using a dimensional star schema and automated synchronization.
Built the frontend with React, TypeScript, Zustand and Tailwind CSS, simplifying features and reorganizing components to improve navigation and user flows.
Integrated GitHub OAuth and GitHub Apps to authenticate users and connect repositories.
Built dashboards with Recharts to visualize commits, pull requests, review times and contributions by developer.

clafcomp-software-ti.description: Management of the institutional platform, technical support and WhatsApp customer service automation to maintain continuity of digital services.
responsibilities: Developed and updated the institutional WordPress website, administered Moodle and provided technical support to staff.
Implemented automated customer service workflows with Meta’s official WhatsApp API and n8n, integrating approved templates.
Managed the technical configuration in Meta Business, including access and permissions for using the WhatsApp API in automated workflows.

clafcomp-certificados.description: Design, development and deployment of a certificate repository with QR code validation, adapted to the limitations of the existing infrastructure.
responsibilities: Built the system with Laravel, Inertia and React, including roles, clients, organizations, signatories and certificates with QR codes for validation and viewing.
Selected the architecture and technologies based on the constraints of the HestiaCP environment and assessed WordPress as a possible solution.
Deployed the system and trained the user, supported by an instructional video serving as a user guide.

cirvos-infraestructura.description: Assessment of DigitalOcean infrastructure and migration of services to a new Hetzner VPS, configuring deployments, domains and storage.
responsibilities: Analyzed backups, resource usage, repositories and dependencies on DigitalOcean to define the migration plan.
Recommended and carried out the migration to Hetzner, configuring the VPS, Coolify, databases, storage and services including n8n, a Python bot and Chatwoot.
Implemented two WordPress websites and configured their domains, DNS records and deployments within the new infrastructure.

neonhouseled-web.description: Development and maintenance of a product management web application, including incident support, integration validation and SEO and performance improvements.
responsibilities: Implemented new features, fixed issues and handled support tickets for the product management system.
Performed functional tests and endpoint validation with Postman to verify services and integrations.
Optimized performance, metadata and indexing with Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights.
Deployed to Hostinger and configured symbolic links to ensure access to application images and files.

sales.title: Sales Management System
sales.description: A system built with Laravel using MVC architecture and Supabase for data management. Queries and filters streamline data entry, search and information management.

retrueque.title: Retrueque
retrueque.description: A platform for exchanging home services through bartering. I developed the frontend with reusable components, responsive views, state management and REST API integration, working with Scrum.

enrollment.title: Enrollment Management System
enrollment.description: A Laravel system featuring user and role management, a statistics dashboard and report generation. MVC architecture separates business logic, the interface and data handling.
